content.comment_body: Hi everyone, I'm experiencing an issue when trying to install [product_name] V6.04 on my PC running Windows XP Professional. The status bar loads during preinstallation, but after finishing, nothing happens—the installation menu does not show up. The same problem occurs on another PC with Windows Vista Home Premium; both systems are 32-bit. If anyone knows why this happens, please let me know. Thanks in advance.
Do you have Jafa installed on your machines? Without it, the installation won't proceed.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a significant installation problem with [product_name] V6.04 on Windows XP Professional and Windows Vista Home Premium, both 32-bit systems. Although the preinstallation bar completes, the installation menu fails to appear, preventing further progress.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the installation menu to display after the preinstallation completes, enabling them to finish installing the software successfully on both systems.
